whyUs.title: Why choose us
whyUs.verifiedBody: Every published profile has passed age verification and human moderation before going live — no exceptions.
whyUs.discretionBody: Contact details are never shown publicly or kept in our logs: revealed on request only, anonymously, no account needed.
whyUs.directContactBody: You contact the provider directly, with no middleman and no commission. We're a listings publisher, not an agency.

footer.disclaimer: Independent listings publisher, for adults only (18 and over).

profileEdit.title: Edit my profile

intro.presentation: Let's start with the essentials. This information will appear on your listing. You can change everything later.
intro.traits: Everything on this page is optional: only fill in what you want to show.
intro.services: Optional: say how you meet clients and your rates. You can skip this step.
intro.availability: Optional: your usual days and hours. You can change them at any time.
intro.photos: Add at least one photo. Our team checks every photo before it becomes visible.
intro.contact: Last step! Your number is never shown directly on the site: a client only sees it after clicking “Show contact”.
